fusions.name: Feeding Pass
fusions.desc: Slashes in from the side, dealing 18 damage and consuming every affliction on an enemy at or below 30% health, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to this blow.

fusions.name: Circling Nip
fusions.desc: Throws a bite that deals 7 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Scent Fever
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Frenzied Gorge
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, you heal for 30% of the damage you deal for 8 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
